_readme: My Server — your own video vault (Telegram / archive.org / any direct MP4).
Every entry in `items` is ONE episode. Entries are produced automatically by
tg-worker/upload.py — upload a file, it prints a JSON block, paste it here.
kind=anime: match by anilistId (preferred) and/or titles (any one of them).
kind=drama: match by dramaSlug (dramacool slug, e.g. queen-of-tears).
episode: number (dramas may use decimals like 16.1).
url: ANY direct video URL with Range support. The Telegram stream URL from
upload.py qualifies; archive.org MP4 links work too (no worker needed).
First matching entry wins — order = priority. Changes need a redeploy (git push).
